versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md for a leaner package.
- Updated model default from u1-insuremed to u2-med in usage instructions and parameters.
- No functional or API changes to skill logic or input/output behavior.

Initial release of the skill for quality control of outpatient medical records regarding hypertension missing maximum blood pressure.

- Implements rule: Detects if maximum blood pressure value is not recorded in hypertension cases.
- Supports text input as well as PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, and JSON formats.
- Calls HiVoice MaaS medical language model for defect detection, returning "无缺陷" or "有缺陷"+reason.
- Ensures data privacy with no local persistence and requires de-identified input.
- No third-party dependencies needed for base logic.
